description: This file defines the implementation of the PlatformCaps class and its nested classes, handling loading and retrieving platform-specific information such as device info, account info, browser details, and capabilities. It interacts with external data sources through the PlatformCapsData class and provides functionality for querying and adding platform-related data.

classes.name: PlatformCaps
classes.description: Main class managing platform capabilities and information. Contains nested classes for AccountInfo and DeviceInfo, each with Load methods to populate data.

classes.name: PlatformCaps::AccountInfo
classes.description: Nested class representing user account information, with a Load method to fetch data based on a query.

classes.name: PlatformCaps::DeviceInfo
classes.description: Nested class representing device information, with a Load method to fetch data based on a query.

methods.name: PlatformCaps::Load
methods.description: Loads platform capabilities based on the provided query string, populating internal data structures accordingly.

methods.name: PlatformCaps::AccountInfo::Load
methods.description: Loads account-related information from external data source based on the query.

methods.name: PlatformCaps::DeviceInfo::Load
methods.description: Loads device-related information from external data source based on the query.
